diaspora_bullets: A record sixth title, won from behind at home in Punjab
India are the first team to complete a hat-trick of Asian Champions Trophy titles
news_summary: India came from a goal down to beat Japan 4-1 in the Men's Asian Champions Trophy final in Mohali on Thursday and lift the trophy for a record sixth time.
payoff: A sixth crown extends India's record as the most successful team in the tournament's history.
